hero.present: I build software end to end: clean interfaces, solid Python APIs, and reliable deployments on AWS. Right now my focus is shipping AI agents and RAG systems to production — software that works in the real world, not demos.
about.description:
Hi! I'm José Alfredo Hernández Argüello, a Costa Rican Full Stack developer with 3+ years of experience building software end to end. I started out in contact center tech support, where I learned to solve problems under pressure and truly understand the end user.

From there I moved into building AI agents. I specialize in backend work with Python and C#/.NET, APIs with FastAPI, and agents with LangChain / LangGraph, backed by solid experience in cloud (AWS) and Linux environments.

I trained as a Computer Application Programming Technician at INA (Costa Rica) and keep learning constantly. If you're looking for someone who combines product thinking, user support, and solid technical development, let's talk.
skills.description: The stack I use to take an idea from the terminal to production, with a focus on AI agents and RAG systems: orchestration with LangChain / LangGraph on AWS Bedrock, APIs in Python, and cloud/Linux deployment — without neglecting either end of the stack.
